ONGC commences crude production from flagship deepwater block KG-DWN-98/2 in Bay of Bengal

25 September 2026
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has successfully commenced commercial crude oil and gas flow from its deepwater Cluster-2 field in the KG-DWN-98/2 block located in water depths ranging from 800m to 1400m offshore Andhra Pradesh.

ONGC commissions 10 MW solar power plant at Hazira plant premises

15 September 2026
As part of green energy initiative, ONGC commissions captive rooftop and ground mounted solar plant at Hazira.
